title: GET LAMP: The Text Adventure Documentary
summary: Jason Scott discusses making his documentary GET LAMP at a Google Tech Talk and screens part of the film. It covers the history of text adventures and interactive fiction, with interviews of Infocom developers and others.
why: HN recommends it to anyone interested in text adventures, Infocom, MUDs and early computer gaming history.

quote.text: Recommend watching “Get lamp” documentary to fans of MUDs, text adventures
